subject.title: feat(android): Talk camera flip control and microphone selection

question: Should Android Talk permanently expose persisted camera-facing and microphone-device preferences, including the selected-device routing behavior, after device proof confirms the implementation across real hardware?
rationale: This is a new persistent user-facing Android control surface, not a repair to an established contract; only maintainers can accept its product scope and the supported hardware-behavior promise.

options.title: Sponsor after device proof
options.body: Keep the proposed opt-in defaults and require redacted physical-device evidence for camera flip and microphone selection/fallback before merge.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Accept only the camera preference or a simpler microphone UI if maintainers do not want to support persistent device selection and its routing semantics yet.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR if Android Talk settings are not a current product priority, preserving the current automatic behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after device proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed opt-in defaults and require redacted physical-device evidence for camera flip and microphone selection/fallback before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current submitted implementation and its stated behavior contract originate from steipete; broader Android ownership could not be verified from the supplied review data.
